root_cause.observed: Pointerup click targets CANVAS; view-call count increments from 1 to 2. Stack identifies HTMLDivElement click handler rather than resize. Document start ID remains unchanged.
root_cause.cause: The stage publishes data-view for inspection. The unrestricted [data-view] preset selector also bound a click handler to that stage. Bubbled canvas click reapplied the current preset after a drag.
root_cause.fix: Restrict preset listener and pressed-state selection to button[data-view]. Remove all temporary diagnostics. Keep resize pose preservation.
